source.title: A Second Opinion
source.description:
I'm not sure what to make of this orb, <name>. I think we will need the help of... a specialist.

We are aware of a warlock sect operating out of Stormwind. Officially we reject the presence of warlocks in the city. Unofficially, their knowledge can be of use when dealing with demonic forces.

Find a representative of these warlocks, and seek their opinion on the orb.
source.objective: Find the warlock sanctum within Stormwind and seek advice on the orb.
source.progress: You're a long way from the cathedral, <class>. I hope you realize you have no authority here.
source.completion: So the Silver Hand requires my aid? It will not come cheaply.
